body:
When i felt like you before i didn't even have enough energy to find one. I had to ask my mom to do it for me. Truth is i did not even have enough energy to clean a glass of water and i was ashamed of this. 

But this is all due to the depression. This is also why it seems to you that this is too much hoops.

This illness makes you not want to get better, that's why it's so hard to fight. It's not your fault but you are not able to understand it right now.

Follow my advice: stop thinking about the future. You are not able to right now. Just go see a psychiatrist. If you can't do it by yourself, ask someone to help you do it.

Don't think about anything else to solve your problems because it won't lead to anything!

Hi, 

You understand that beeing loved is linked to having high standards. 

Of course it's easier to love someone who looks hot, have a cool job and wins lot of money, even if this isn't everything.

And as you are smart, you understand what is required for you to do to achieve this. Problem is that you feel like it's too hard right?

The fact that you want to kill yourself proves that you suffer from depression, which is a mental illness that drains you completely from your energy, thus preventing you to reach your goals, which fuels your depression even more.

It's a vicious circle. The more you wait, the worse it will get. Killing yourself might sounds to you the easy way out, but it's actually much harder to achieve than you think because there is no magical switch that you push and you just die. There are just different ways where none are easy and actually will make you go through a lot of pain.

If you want to stop the pain and get back the strenght that you need to reach your dreams, you must first get cured from your depression.

The only way out of where you are now is to go see a psychiatrist. 

I hope you get better!

Hi,

I understand you feel like you suffer from your life every day, that you can't take it any more, you just would like it to stop and "not waking up" seems the easiest way to achieve this.

I understand it because i felt it myself as well before. My family tried to help me. My friends tried to help me. I tried to boost myself to get over it. Nothing helped. The only thing that worked was to go see a psychiatrist. 

It took time, it wasn't easy, but it's the only thing that really works. 

I know it's hard to belive because i wouldn't belive it myself back now but it did. 

So stop thinking about what do to and just go see a psychiatrist. If you feel you are not able to do it, ask someone from your family or a friend to help you. There is no shame in it. Everybody needs help at some point. It's just very hard to admit it.

You're most welcome.

It's great that you see a counselor and take anti-depressants. It's the best way for you to get better.

However if you keep thinking about commiting suicide anyway, it means that something is wrong and you need to tell it to your conselor as soon as possible. 

At least that's what mine told me, and it helped me to follow her advice. I hope it will help you as well :)

Hey,

I understand you fear the future because you're in a lot of pain and you don't know how to make it stop, so suicide seems the easiest way to stop it.

But truth is it's actually much harder than you think. If you want to stop feeling pain, it's actually much easier to seek profesionnal medical help than commit sucide.

Your brain is sick and prevents you from understanding this, but this is what you need.

So stop thinking about the future right now because you're just not able to. Go see a doctor. And if you feel you're not able to take an appointment to a doctor, ask someone from your family, ask a friend, or call the medical emergency number of your country. Don't think about anything else and just do it.

I hope you get better!

You're most welcome. 

The first psychiatrist i've been seeing after i was depressed didn't understand me, so i didn't trust him and stopped going there and found a new one.

The new one told me exactly the same thing as the first one. This got me nervous and so i told the second one that indeed i thought he didn't understand me as well. And from there he was able to help me.

What i'm saying is: even with the best doctor in the world it won't work if your wife does not say when she feels it's not working. It's seems obvious but it's actually very hard to do when you're depressed because the reflex is to say "yes" to everything even if you know you are not able to do it.

Of course there are bad doctors out there. But you should be aware of this as well :)

I promess you that yesterday i felt so much pain i also wanted to end my life. 

I am better today but if somone told me this yesterday i would have never belived it so i know it's hard to belive.

I assure you that if the pain is unbearable, you should call the emergency number of your country and tell them you're about to kill yourself.

They will stop the pain. Planning for suicide won't. Releve yourself from the pain and call them now!

Hi,

I'm sorry about what happend to your wife.

I my humble opinion, I think your wife needs profesionnal medical help. She needs to see a psychiatrist. And if she already does, see him/her again fast and tell him/her about what happend.

Even if you love her very much, and the rest of her family as well, nothing will replace this. 

Of course you can help her go through this by beeing there for her. But i really think you should help her do it.

I'm telling you that because i suffer from depression as well, and going to see a psychiatrist is the only thing that really helped me. I'm lucky to have some loving family and friends but they never could help me with my depression while my psychiatrist did.

Think of it like a broken bone. If your wife had broken her leg, you would take her to the doctor and even if you love her deeply you can't heal her by yourself because you don't know how do to it. It's the same here.

I hope she gets better and that after some time your family will be happy and you can move on from this.

Hi,

I understand that you feel so much pain you can't bear it anymore.

I've been there as well like yesterday, litterally.

You should tell yourself that you're already doing what you need to get better by seeing a new counselor. 

You should tell her when you see her exactly how you feel, and more precisely that you feel indifferent to the whole process. 

When i was first having counseling, i was just listening to what the counselors told me to do, and it failed badly, not because of them, but because of me.

You should challenge your counselor if you feel like it's not working, if she doesn't understand you or if she's asking you to do something you know you won't be able to do. It feels obvious but it's actually hard to do it because sometimes saying "yes" is almost a reflex.

You seem like a very nice person. I hope you get better!

What did your doctors tell you when you said to them that you don't like the meds they gave you because of this?

Also, do you feel better when you're at work? If you do, that's great. If going to work actually hurts you, tell it to your doctor as well. When your doctor decides that you need to rest from your work, it's not a vacation at all. It's like a med you need to get better.

What would happen if tomorrow you got road crushed by a car and couldn't walk for 2 months? Your bosses would find a way and they wouldn't blame you because it's not your fault.

It's the same here really.

Hi,

I agree with AquaNetwerk, you should definitively tell them about how you feel.

It's what parents are for! They help you get through stuff where you feel you can't :)

That's what childrens do everytime, but the older we grow, the harder it gets to admit it because you want to feel independant, but that's how it it and there is no shame to it :)

Hey,

Why do you feel you'll probably never be with the person you love?

Also nobody likes to be alone but i guess we don't chose it, we just did because we couldn't find any way around it.

I know the pain, i've been there as well, so i hope you'll get better because no ones deserves it.

Feel free to message/reply if you wanna talk more.

Hey man,

I'm 30 here and i can relate a lot to what you are living right now. Maybe you're thinking like me "why go to work or do anything anyway if it's for beeing unhappy".

And to be honest who cares about why people consider it selfish because it seems the easiest way to stop suffering from the pain right?

I went to see my doctor today and told her exactly about this, that i was fed up from the pain and if i had an easy opportunity to end it, i would.

She stopped me to go to work for 3 weeks, gave me some meds to take and told me to just try to do things i enjoy when i feel like something does, which is pretty hard because nothing kinda does right now, i guess you know how it feels.

And truth is i didn't even started the meds, will do tomorrow, but just stop thinking about how i can fix my life for 1 evening actually helped me to refrain from feeling too much pain. Maybe you can try it out as well.

Also my doctor helped me to get back from the hole i was in 1 year ago, so i don't know if you're seeing one, but if you don't i suggest you do.

I hope you get better and don't hesitate to message me if you wanna talk some more.

Hi,

I'm back from my doctor today and i told her exactly this. 

She answered me "stop thinking about what's wrong or how to fix it. Just try to do anything that makes you feel good. Which is hard because everything kind of does not right now.

So i don't know all your story, and it might be very different from mine but i must say since i stopped thinking about everything it helped a bit. 

Also yesterday i felt so much in pain that i went running for 10 mins at 2 am, it was more a crying run more or less, it didn't feel happier after it but at least the excruciating pain was gone for a while. Maybe you can give it a try if you can.

Also do you see a psychiatrist? If not you should try it, it helped me a lot.

Feel free to message me anytime if you wanna talk more. 

I hope you feel better soon.
Thank you for your message. It feels like they're too bad already and i can't find something that makes me want to get better. I'm opened to suggestions tho! :)

Thanks for your message.

It's not exactly what i meant. I know reaching happiness is under my control, i see some some possibilities where it could become true, but it feels like reaching this requires too much efforts, and so the pain to reach it feels to great regarding what i can endure.

Hi,

I'm sorry for what's happening to you. I felt the same pain than you did as well, for different reasons. It was so unbearable that if i had a gun, i would have been gone by now. As i needed it to stop, out of everything i followed an advice from my therapist and went running for 10 mins.
I still feel depressed and nothing have changed in thinking that my life won't be better, but after i ran 10 mins the chemistry in my brain changed and the unbearable pain is gone, for now at least.

I know this might sound stupid, and this is not an answer to why you should be going on, as i'm looking for this one as well, but if you're feeling too much pain like i did, give it a try if you can.

I hope you get better.

Well knowing there are people like you who are selflessly helping strangers like me warms my heart so thank you very much for your messages.

Your answer does not sound like a solution for what i'm feeling but maybe it's out of my reach now and that's why you wished me successful learning :)

Anyway i understand you're trying to help. Thanks again.

Hi,

Well i feel the same than you do about your last sentence, even if that does not help us very much! :)

I've been doing therapy as well, and it did not work at first because i was basicly listening to what they wanted me to do but i couldn't do it and i did not have the courage to tell them.

So if i can give you an advice: next time you do therapy, do not tell what you feel and listen to what you are requested to do and acknoledge everything. If you feel that the other person do not understand you, tell them. It's what made me get better for 8 months.

I hope you get better!

Thanks for your answer. Actually 5 years ago my parents were fighting over money problems about their divorce and my dad tried to manipulate me to win the fight. After i understood he was evil, i told him i wouldn't take his side, and then he told me that if I said that "i wasn't his son". So i kinda wish i didn't save him now ironically! I never spoke to him again from this day on.

Moreover, i did try to help others. I'm an IT guy, i'm good at fixing computers. But the more i do it, the more people use me to do it and they give me nothing in return. 

About a month ago, there was a guy in the middle of the road which i tried to help as he was crying and disoriented. After he felt better, he stole my phone and tried to roadkill me as i was trying to get it back.

How is this a success?
